description.zh: 全球最大的公开化学信息库，可按名称、结构或 CAS 号检索化合物性质、生物活性与文献。
description.en: The world's largest public chemistry database; search compound properties, biological activities, and literature by name, structure, or CAS number.

description.zh: 英国皇家化学会（RSC）维护的结构数据库，聚合数百万化合物的性质与外部来源链接。
description.en: Structure database maintained by the Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC), aggregating properties and external source links for millions of compounds.

description.zh: CAS 官方免费子库，适合用 CAS 号快速核对常用化学品的基础性质。
description.en: CAS official free sub-database, suitable for quickly checking basic properties of common chemicals by CAS number.

description.zh: NIST 热化学、热物理与光谱数据总入口，气相离子热化学数据尤其实用。
description.en: NIST main entry for thermochemical, thermophysical and spectral data; gas-phase ion thermochemistry data is especially useful.

description.zh: EBI 的化学本体数据库，提供化合物本体注释及其与生物医学实体的关联。
description.en: EBI's chemical ontology database, providing compound ontology annotations and their relationships with biomedical entities.

description.zh: Elsevier 的反应与物质性质检索平台，支持逆合成分析与文献实验数据回溯。
description.en: Elsevier's reaction and substance property search platform, supporting retrosynthetic analysis and retrospective literature experimental data.

description.zh: CAS 旗舰检索平台，覆盖文献、物质、反应与专利，适合系统查新与专利检索。
description.en: CAS flagship search platform, covering literature, substances, reactions and patents, suitable for systematic novelty and patent searches.

description.zh: 计算化学基准数据库，汇集实验与计算的几何、能量、振动频率等，可直接对比方法误差。
description.en: Computational chemistry benchmark database compiling experimental and calculated geometries, energies, vibrational frequencies, etc., for direct method error comparison.

description.zh: Grimme 组的主族热化学与反应能基准集，DFT 方法评测的事实标准之一。
description.en: Grimme group's main-group thermochemistry and reaction energy benchmark set, one of the de facto standards for DFT method evaluation.

description.zh: Truhlar 组维护的多样基准库集合（M06、S22、MGCDB84 等），含几何与能量数据。
description.en: A collection of diverse benchmark sets maintained by the Truhlar group (M06, S22, MGCDB84, etc.), including geometries and energies.

description.zh: Active Thermochemical Tables，通过网络化评估给出高精度生成焓与键能。
description.en: Active Thermochemical Tables, providing high-precision enthalpies of formation and bond energies through networked evaluation.

description.zh: 经典热力学函数表，提供物质在宽温区内的 Cp、S、H 以及平衡常数。
description.en: Classic thermodynamic function tables providing Cp, S, H and equilibrium constants over a wide temperature range.

description.zh: NASA 多项式热化学数据库，燃烧与反应机理建模的常用参数来源。
description.en: NASA polynomial thermochemistry database, a common parameter source for combustion and reaction mechanism modeling.

description.zh: 燃烧反应机理与实验数据平台，含点火延迟、火焰速度等模型验证数据。
description.en: Combustion reaction mechanism and experimental data platform, including ignition delay, flame speed, and other model validation data.

description.zh: 气相化学动力学实验数据检索库，可按反应物或产物查速率常数。
description.en: Gas-phase chemical kinetics experimental data retrieval database; search rate constants by reactant or product.

description.zh: IUPAC 气相动力学数据评估项目（现由 AERIS 托管），提供经评审的速率常数与光解数据。
description.en: IUPAC gas-phase kinetics data evaluation project (now hosted by AERIS), providing reviewed rate constants and photolysis data.

description.zh: 基组与赝势的一站式检索、下载平台，支持主流量化程序格式转换。
description.en: One-stop retrieval and download platform for basis sets and pseudopotentials, supporting format conversion for mainstream quantum chemistry programs.

description.zh: Materials Cloud 的标准固体赝势库，为可复现的固体 DFT 计算提供推荐设置。
description.en: Materials Cloud's standard solid-state pseudopotential library, providing recommended settings for reproducible solid-state DFT calculations.

description.zh: 开源交换-相关泛函库，被主流量化与固体电子结构程序广泛调用。
description.en: Open-source exchange-correlation functional library used by major quantum chemistry and solid-state electronic structure programs.

description.zh: 美国能源部支持的 DFT 材料数据库，可检索结构、能带、相图与电池、催化性质。
description.en: US DOE-supported DFT materials database with searchable structures, band structures, phase diagrams, and battery/catalytic properties.

description.zh: 开放量子材料数据库，提供百万级无机化合物的形成能与结构稳定性数据。
description.en: Open quantum materials database, providing formation energies and structural stability data for millions of inorganic compounds.

description.zh: 高通量材料计算平台，提供结构原型、热力学与电子性质等大规模数据。
description.en: High-throughput materials computation platform providing large-scale data on structural prototypes, thermodynamics, and electronic properties.

description.zh: 欧洲的原始计算数据仓库，可上传、检索海量 DFT 计算数据及其元数据。
description.en: Europe's raw computational data repository; upload and search massive DFT calculation data and metadata.

description.zh: NIST 的材料与分子数据平台，含 DFT 性质、力场与机器学习工具。
description.en: NIST's materials and molecular data platform, with DFT properties, force fields and machine learning tools.

description.zh: EPFL 托管的开放材料数据与工具门户，含二维材料、SSSP 与 AiiDA 工作流。
description.en: Open materials data and tools portal hosted by EPFL, including 2D materials, SSSP and AiiDA workflows.

description.zh: 二维材料计算数据库，提供数百种单层材料的结构稳定性与电子、磁性质。
description.en: 2D materials computational database, offering structural stability and electronic and magnetic properties for hundreds of monolayer materials.

description.zh: 无机晶体结构数据库，收录实验测定的晶体结构，通常需机构订阅。
description.en: Inorganic Crystal Structure Database, contains experimentally determined crystal structures, usually requires institutional subscription.

description.zh: 剑桥结构数据库（CSD），有机与金属有机晶体结构的权威来源。
description.en: Cambridge Structural Database (CSD), authoritative source for organic and metal-organic crystal structures.

description.zh: 开放晶体学数据库，免费提供数十万条晶体结构 CIF 文件。
description.en: Open crystallography database providing free CIF files for hundreds of thousands of structures.

description.zh: 矿物与相关固体的晶体结构库，适合矿物学与地球化学研究。
description.en: A crystal structure database of minerals and related solids, suitable for mineralogy and geochemistry research.

description.zh: 晶体学对称性服务器，可查空间群、不可约表示与相变对称性。
description.en: Crystallographic symmetry server, search space groups, irreducible representations and phase transition symmetries.

description.zh: 催化表面吸附能与反应能数据库，汇总多个研究组的 DFT 计算结果。
description.en: Database of catalytic surface adsorption energies and reaction energies, aggregating DFT results from multiple research groups.

description.zh: 材料机器学习基准套件，含 13 个性质预测任务与固定数据划分。
description.en: Materials machine learning benchmark suite including 13 property prediction tasks and fixed data splits.

description.zh: 材料发现专用基准，评估机器学习势函数在稳定材料筛选中的实际表现。
description.en: Benchmark dedicated to materials discovery, evaluating the actual performance of machine learning potentials in stable material screening.

description.zh: 实验测定的蛋白质与核酸三维结构总库，结构生物学与分子对接的起点。
description.en: Repository of experimentally determined 3D structures of proteins and nucleic acids, the starting point for structural biology and molecular docking.

description.zh: AlphaFold 预测的蛋白结构库，覆盖数百万物种的蛋白质组。
description.en: AlphaFold-predicted protein structure database, covering proteomes of millions of species.

description.zh: 冷冻电镜密度图数据库，与 PDB 中的原子模型互相补充。
description.en: Cryo-EM density map database, complementing atomic models in the PDB.

description.zh: 蛋白序列与功能注释的权威数据库，可直接下载 FASTA 用于建模。
description.en: Authoritative database of protein sequences and functional annotations; FASTA can be downloaded directly for modeling.

description.zh: 生物大分子核磁共振数据银行，收录化学位移、结构约束与弛豫数据。
description.en: Biological macromolecule NMR data bank, collecting chemical shifts, structural constraints, and relaxation data.

description.zh: 蛋白-配体复合物结合亲和力数据集，广泛用于打分函数开发与机器学习训练。
description.en: Protein-ligand complex binding affinity dataset widely used for scoring function development and machine learning training.

description.zh: 公开的结合亲和力数据库，可按靶点或化合物检索 Ki、Kd 与 IC50。
description.en: Public binding affinity database; search Ki, Kd, and IC50 by target or compound.

description.zh: 大规模蛋白-配体相互作用数据集，提供高质量结构、界面标注与划分。
description.en: Large-scale protein-ligand interaction dataset providing high-quality structures, interface annotations and splits.

description.zh: EBI 的生物活性数据库，整合药物、靶点与测定数据，是药物机器学习首选。
description.en: EBI's bioactivity database integrating drug, target and assay data; the first choice for drug machine learning.

description.zh: 药物与靶点知识库，含已上市及在研药物信息，学术访问免费。
description.en: Drug and target knowledgebase with marketed and investigational drug information; free academic access.

description.zh: 可购买化合物的虚拟筛选库，提供多种预处理格式与三维构象。
description.en: Virtual screening library of purchasable compounds, offering multiple preprocessed formats and 3D conformations.

description.zh: 超大规模可合成化合物库，适合按需订购与十亿级虚拟筛选。
description.en: Ultra-large make-on-demand compound libraries, suitable for billion-scale virtual screening.

description.zh: IUPHAR 的受体、离子通道与配体数据库，人工注释质量高。
description.en: IUPHAR's receptor, ion channel and ligand database with high-quality manual annotation.

description.zh: 分子对接评测的诱饵分子集，用于检验虚拟筛选方法的富集能力。
description.en: Decoy molecule set for molecular docking evaluation, used to test enrichment ability of virtual screening methods.

description.zh: 美国联邦毒理研究计划数据门户，提供 21 世纪毒理学测试数据。
description.en: US federal toxicology program data portal, offering 21st-century toxicology testing data.

description.zh: 美国 EPA 化学品仪表盘，整合毒性、暴露与化学性质数据。
description.en: US EPA Chemicals Dashboard, integrating toxicity, exposure and chemical property data.

description.zh: 在线 ADMET 性质预测平台，输入 SMILES 即可获得成药性与安全性评估。
description.en: Online ADMET property prediction platform: enter a SMILES to get drug-likeness and safety assessment.

description.zh: 治疗数据共享平台，汇集药物发现相关的机器学习数据集与基准。
description.en: Therapeutic data sharing platform, aggregating machine learning datasets and benchmarks for drug discovery.

description.zh: 人类代谢组数据库，收录代谢物结构、浓度与疾病关联信息。
description.en: Human Metabolome Database, containing metabolite structures, concentrations, and disease associations.

description.zh: Scripps 的代谢物质谱数据库，支持 MS/MS 谱图匹配与代谢物鉴定。
description.en: Scripps metabolomics mass spectrometry database, supporting MS/MS spectral matching and metabolite identification.

description.zh: 开放质谱数据库，汇总多台仪器的正、负离子实测谱图。
description.en: Open mass spectrometry database aggregating positive- and negative-ion spectra from multiple instruments.

description.zh: 天然产物化学结构数据库，适合天然产物虚拟筛选与化学空间分析。
description.en: Database of natural product chemical structures, suitable for virtual screening of natural products and chemical space analysis.

description.zh: 开放反应数据库，标准化存储反应条件与实验结果，并提供 API。
description.en: Open reaction database, with standardised storage of reaction conditions and experimental results, and an API.

description.zh: Lowe 整理的美国专利反应数据（1976–2016），反应预测机器学习模型的经典训练集。
description.en: US patent reaction data compiled by Lowe (1976–2016), a classic training set for reaction prediction machine learning models.

description.zh: 开源电子实验记录与反应数据仓库，可发布可引用的实验数据集。
description.en: Open-source electronic lab notebook and reaction data repository, can publish citable experimental datasets.

description.zh: 生化反应数据库，提供酶催化的反应方程式与层级分类。
description.en: Biochemical reaction database, providing enzyme-catalyzed reaction equations and hierarchical classification.

description.zh: 酶功能与动力学数据库，含 Km、kcat、抑制剂与生物来源信息。
description.en: Enzyme function and kinetics database with Km, kcat, inhibitors and biological source information.

description.zh: 京都基因与基因组百科，提供代谢通路、酶与化合物之间的关联。
description.en: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, providing links between metabolic pathways, enzymes, and compounds.

description.zh: 高分辨率分子光谱数据库，大气探测与燃烧诊断的标准谱线来源。
description.en: High-resolution molecular spectroscopy database, standard line source for atmospheric sounding and combustion diagnostics.

description.zh: 系外行星与高温分子谱线库，覆盖大量小分子的完整 rovibronic 谱线。
description.en: Exoplanet and high-temperature molecular line database, covering complete rovibronic lines for many small molecules.

description.zh: JPL 微波、毫米波分子谱线目录，射电天文与气相光谱研究常用。
description.en: JPL microwave and millimeter-wave molecular spectral line catalog, commonly used in radio astronomy and gas-phase spectroscopy research.

description.zh: 科隆分子光谱数据库，提供气相分子的转动与振动谱线数据。
description.en: Cologne Molecular Spectroscopy Database, providing rotational and vibrational line data for gas-phase molecules.

description.zh: 日本 AIST 谱图数据库，可检索 IR、Raman、NMR 与 MS 实测谱。
description.en: Japanese AIST spectral database, search IR, Raman, NMR, and MS measured spectra.

description.zh: NIST 原子光谱数据库，提供原子能级、谱线与跃迁概率。
description.en: NIST atomic spectra database, providing atomic energy levels, spectral lines and transition probabilities.

description.zh: 13.4 万个小有机分子的量子化学性质（几何、能量、振动等），分子机器学习入门标配。
description.en: Quantum chemical properties of 134,000 small organic molecules (geometry, energy, vibrations, etc.), a standard entry point for molecular machine learning.

description.zh: 经典分子机器学习数据集族，含库仑矩阵表示与分子动力学轨迹的能量、受力数据。
description.en: Classic family of molecular machine learning datasets, including Coulomb matrix representations and energy/force data from molecular dynamics trajectories.

description.zh: 约两千万个小分子构象的 DFT 能量数据集，ANI 系列机器学习势函数的训练基础。
description.en: DFT energy dataset for ~20 million small molecule conformers, the training basis for the ANI series of machine learning potentials.

description.zh: Open Catalyst 项目的大规模催化表面吸附数据集，用于训练通用机器学习势函数。
description.en: Large-scale catalytic surface adsorption dataset from the Open Catalyst project, for training universal machine learning potentials.

description.zh: 基于 PubChem 的大规模电子结构数据库，含 2.2 亿分子的 PM6 与 8600 万分子的 B3LYP 数据。
description.en: Large-scale electronic structure database based on PubChem, containing PM6 data for 220 million molecules and B3LYP data for 86 million molecules.

description.zh: 数百万个无机晶体的 DFT 计算数据库（PBE、PBEsol、SCAN），带能量、力和应力，可用 OPTIMADE 查询，常用来训练材料的机器学习势和稳定性预测模型。
description.en: A DFT database of millions of inorganic crystals (PBE, PBEsol, SCAN) with energies, forces and stresses, queryable over OPTIMADE and widely used to train machine-learned potentials and stability models for materials.

description.zh: 过渡金属配合物的量子化学数据集，填补有机分子数据集在金属化学上的空白。
description.en: Quantum chemistry dataset of transition metal complexes, filling the gap in metal chemistry left by organic molecule datasets.

description.zh: MolSSI 的量子化学计算数据平台，可检索、共享与复用计算结果。
description.en: MolSSI's quantum chemistry calculation data platform, allowing search, sharing and reuse of calculation results.

description.zh: 图神经网络基准套件，包含分子图性质预测等任务与标准划分。
description.en: Graph neural network benchmark suite with tasks like molecular graph property prediction and standard splits.

description.zh: DeepChem 生态的分子机器学习数据集与 MoleculeNet 基准合集。
description.en: Molecular machine learning datasets from the DeepChem ecosystem and the MoleculeNet benchmark collection.

description.zh: NIST 原子间势函数库，收录 EAM、MEAM 等经典势参数与评估工具。
description.en: NIST interatomic potential repository, containing classical potential parameters such as EAM, MEAM and evaluation tools.

description.zh: 学术免费的高效量子化学程序，DFT、MP2、CCSD(T) 与多参考方法齐全。
description.en: Efficient quantum chemistry program free for academics, with complete DFT, MP2, CCSD(T) and multireference methods.

description.zh: 商业量子化学软件的标杆，方法覆盖广、生态成熟、教程与文献极多。
description.en: The benchmark commercial quantum chemistry software: broad method coverage, mature ecosystem, abundant tutorials and literature.

description.zh: 商业量子化学程序，擅长激发态、溶剂化与高端电子结构方法。
description.en: Commercial quantum chemistry program, strong in excited states, solvation, and high-level electronic structure methods.

description.zh: 开源量子化学程序，适合脚本化工作流、方法开发与教学。
description.en: Open-source quantum chemistry program, suitable for scripted workflows, method development, and teaching.

description.zh: 开源大规模并行量子化学程序，适合集群上的大体系计算。
description.en: Open-source massively parallel quantum chemistry program, suitable for large systems on clusters.

description.zh: 经典开源量子化学程序，方法齐全、教程与社区资源丰富。
description.en: Classic open-source quantum chemistry program with comprehensive methods, tutorials and community resources.

description.zh: 开源固体与液体 DFT、分子动力学程序，擅长大规模周期体系。
description.en: Open-source DFT and molecular dynamics program for solids and liquids, excels at large-scale periodic systems.

description.zh: 开源平面波 DFT 程序，固体与赝势计算的标准工具之一。
description.en: Open-source plane-wave DFT program, one of the standard tools for solid-state and pseudopotential calculations.

description.zh: 商业平面波 DFT 程序，材料科学与表面催化领域使用极广。
description.en: Commercial plane-wave DFT program, widely used in materials science and surface catalysis.

description.zh: 开源分子动力学引擎，擅长大规模体系、粗粒化模型与自定义势函数。
description.en: Open-source molecular dynamics engine, strong in large systems, coarse-grained models, and custom potentials.

description.zh: 开源生物分子分子动力学程序，性能与生态俱佳。
description.en: Open-source biomolecular molecular dynamics program, excellent performance and ecosystem.

description.zh: GPU 加速的分子动力学工具包，适合自定义力场与 Python 工作流。
description.en: GPU-accelerated molecular dynamics toolkit, suitable for custom force fields and Python workflows.

description.zh: 开源分子对接程序，速度与精度平衡，常用于虚拟筛选与结合模式预测。
description.en: Open-source molecular docking program, balancing speed and accuracy, commonly used for virtual screening and binding mode prediction.

description.zh: 开源化学信息学工具包，分子读写、描述符计算与构象生成必备。
description.en: Open-source cheminformatics toolkit, essential for molecular I/O, descriptor calculation, and conformer generation.

description.zh: 原子模拟环境，统一封装多种 DFT 与分子动力学程序，适合高通量筛选。
description.en: Atomic simulation environment, unified wrapper for multiple DFT and molecular dynamics programs, suitable for high-throughput screening.

description.zh: 材料计算工作流与数据管理平台，强调可复现性与数据溯源。
description.en: Materials computation workflow and data management platform, emphasizing reproducibility and data provenance.

description.zh: 跨平台分子建模与可视化工具，适合搭建与检查初始结构。
description.en: Cross-platform molecular modelling and visualization tool, suitable for building and inspecting initial structures.

description.zh: 分子科学软件研究所，提供软件、数据集、标准与培训资源。
description.en: Molecular Sciences Software Institute, providing software, datasets, standards, and training resources.

description.zh: 波函数分析与可视化程序，支持电子密度、EDA、NCI、激发态等分析，中文教程完善。
description.en: Wavefunction analysis and visualization program, supporting electron density, EDA, NCI, excited states, etc., with comprehensive Chinese tutorials.

description.zh: 云端量子化学平台，可通过网页或 API 提交任务，适合快速获得可靠性质。
description.en: Cloud quantum chemistry platform, submit tasks via web or API, suitable for quickly obtaining reliable properties.

description.zh: 中文计算化学社区，教程、答疑与软件资源丰富，适合入门与查错。
description.en: Chinese computational chemistry community with rich tutorials, Q&A, and software resources, ideal for getting started and troubleshooting.

description.zh: Sobereva 的博客，含大量量子化学入门、Multiwfn 与实用技巧长文。
description.en: Sobereva's blog, containing many long articles on quantum chemistry introductions, Multiwfn, and practical tips.

description.zh: 中文化学与材料文献平台，可跟踪期刊、主题与最新研究进展。
description.en: Chinese chemistry and materials literature platform for tracking journals, topics, and the latest research progress.

description.zh: Computational Chemistry List，国际计算化学邮件列表与资源索引。
description.en: Computational Chemistry List, international computational chemistry mailing list and resource index.

description.zh: 以高精度多参考与耦合簇方法见长的量子化学程序，CASSCF/MRCI/CCSD(T)-F12 等波函数方法的常用参考。
description.en: Quantum chemistry program known for high-accuracy multireference and coupled cluster methods; a common reference for wavefunction methods like CASSCF/MRCI/CCSD(T)-F12.

description.zh: 开源的多参考量子化学程序（Molcas 开源版），擅长 CASSCF/RASSCF、CASPT2 与过渡金属、激发态体系。
description.en: Open-source multireference quantum chemistry program (open-source Molcas), excelling in CASSCF/RASSCF, CASPT2, and transition metal and excited-state systems.

description.zh: 专注耦合簇方法的量子化学程序，CCSD(T)、EOM-CC 与解析梯度、振动光谱性质计算是其强项。
description.en: Quantum chemistry program focused on coupled cluster methods; strengths include CCSD(T), EOM-CC, analytic gradients, and vibrational spectroscopic properties.

description.zh: 高阶耦合簇与局域相关方法程序，可做任意阶 CC 计算和大体系的局域 CCSD(T)。
description.en: Program for high-order coupled cluster and local correlation methods, capable of arbitrary-order CC calculations and local CCSD(T) for large systems.

description.zh: 开源量子化学程序，以响应理论计算分子性质（极化率、NMR、光谱）见长。
description.en: Open-source quantum chemistry program renowned for calculating molecular properties (polarizabilities, NMR, spectra) using response theory.

description.zh: 相对论量子化学程序，基于四分量 Dirac–Coulomb 哈密顿量，适合重元素体系。
description.en: Relativistic quantum chemistry program based on the four-component Dirac–Coulomb Hamiltonian, suitable for heavy-element systems.

description.zh: 相对论量子化学程序，侧重重元素体系的 EPR/NMR 参数和光谱性质计算。
description.en: Relativistic quantum chemistry program focused on calculating EPR/NMR parameters and spectroscopic properties for heavy-element systems.

description.zh: 高效的商业量子化学程序，RI 近似下的 DFT、MP2、CC2 与激发态计算速度快。
description.en: Efficient commercial quantum chemistry program, fast DFT, MP2, CC2, and excited-state calculations under RI approximation.

description.zh: 开源的多参考电子结构程序，支持 CASSCF、CASPT2、MRCI 及相对论计算。
description.en: Open-source multireference electronic structure program supporting CASSCF, CASPT2, MRCI, and relativistic calculations.

description.zh: 以选择组态相互作用（CIPSI）为核心的开源程序，可逼近全组态相互作用（FCI）精度。
description.en: Open-source program centered on selected configuration interaction (CIPSI), approaching full configuration interaction (FCI) accuracy.

description.zh: 高效的密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）量子化学程序，可与 PySCF 联用处理强关联体系。
description.en: Efficient density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) quantum chemistry program, can be used with PySCF to handle strongly correlated systems.

description.zh: 面向量子化学的自旋自适应 DMRG 库，可作为 CASSCF 的活性空间求解器。
description.en: Spin-adapted DMRG library for quantum chemistry, usable as an active space solver for CASSCF.

description.zh: 全组态相互作用量子蒙特卡罗（FCIQMC）程序，用随机方法求解大活性空间问题。
description.en: Full configuration interaction quantum Monte Carlo (FCIQMC) program, using stochastic methods to solve large active space problems.

description.zh: 开源量子蒙特卡罗程序，可做变分与扩散蒙特卡罗（VMC/DMC），适用于分子与固体。
description.en: Open-source quantum Monte Carlo program for variational and diffusion Monte Carlo (VMC/DMC), applicable to molecules and solids.

description.zh: 经典的量子蒙特卡罗程序，用于分子、固体和二维材料的高精度 DMC 计算。
description.en: Classic quantum Monte Carlo program for high-precision DMC calculations on molecules, solids, and two-dimensional materials.

description.zh: 经典半经验量子化学程序（PM6、PM7 等），2022 年起开源，适合大分子的快速计算。
description.en: Classic semiempirical quantum chemistry program (PM6, PM7, etc.), open-sourced since 2022, suitable for fast calculations on large molecules.

description.zh: SCINE 项目的半经验方法库，提供 MNDO、AM1、PM6、DFTB 等快速电子结构计算。
description.en: Semiempirical method library from the SCINE project, providing MNDO, AM1, PM6, DFTB and other fast electronic structure calculations.

description.zh: 基于 xtb 的构象与质子化态搜索工具，常用于计算前的构象系综生成。
description.en: xtb-based conformational and protonation state search tool, often used for generating conformational ensembles before calculations.

description.zh: Grimme 课题组的 D4 色散校正库，可与多数 DFT 程序和泛函配合使用。
description.en: The Grimme group's D4 dispersion correction library, compatible with most DFT programs and functionals.

description.zh: DFT-D3 色散校正的重新实现，带 Python 接口，便于在各类程序中调用。
description.en: Reimplementation of DFT-D3 dispersion correction with a Python interface for use in various programs.

description.zh: 轻量的紧束缚（GFN-xTB）计算库，提供 Python 接口，可嵌入其他工作流。
description.en: Lightweight tight-binding (GFN-xTB) computational library with Python interface, embeddable in other workflows.

description.zh: 高斯基组分子积分库，被 Psi4、ORCA、CP2K 等众多程序使用。
description.en: Gaussian basis set molecular integral library, used by many programs such as Psi4, ORCA, CP2K.

description.zh: PySCF 使用的高斯积分库，支持多种积分与导数，速度快、接口简单。
description.en: Gaussian integral library used by PySCF, supporting many integrals and derivatives; fast and with a simple interface.

description.zh: MolSSI 的统一计算执行层，用同一套 QCSchema 输入调用 Psi4、ORCA、xtb 等多种程序。
description.en: MolSSI's unified computational execution layer, calling Psi4, ORCA, xtb and others via the same QCSchema input.

description.zh: QM/MM 多尺度计算平台，可把量子化学程序与分子力学程序组合起来模拟酶与材料表面。
description.en: QM/MM multiscale computing platform for combining quantum chemistry and molecular mechanics programs to simulate enzymes and material surfaces.

description.zh: 基于数值原子轨道的全电子第一性原理程序，可处理分子与周期体系，杂化泛函和 GW 计算效率高。
description.en: All-electron first-principles program based on numerical atomic orbitals, capable of handling molecular and periodic systems with efficient hybrid functional and GW calculations.

description.zh: 基于数值原子轨道的线性标度 DFT 程序，适合含数千原子的大体系。
description.en: Linear-scaling DFT program based on numerical atomic orbitals, suitable for large systems with thousands of atoms.

description.zh: 基于 PAW 方法的 Python DFT 程序，可用实空间网格、平面波或原子轨道基组，与 ASE 深度集成。
description.en: Python DFT program based on the PAW method, using real-space grids, plane waves, or atomic orbital basis sets, deeply integrated with ASE.

description.zh: 实空间、实时含时密度泛函（TDDFT）程序，用于激发态、光吸收与强场动力学。
description.en: Real-space, real-time time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) program for excited states, optical absorption, and strong-field dynamics.

description.zh: 全电子 LAPW 方法的经典固体电子结构程序，常作为能带与电子结构计算的高精度参考。
description.en: Classic solid-state electronic structure program using the all-electron LAPW method, often a high-accuracy reference for band structure and electronic structure calculations.

description.zh: 平面波赝势 DFT 程序，学术用户可免费获取，商业版集成在 BIOVIA Materials Studio。
description.en: Plane-wave pseudopotential DFT program, freely available for academic users, with a commercial version integrated into BIOVIA Materials Studio.

description.zh: 全电子 LAPW 程序，侧重激发态：GW、BSE 与 TDDFT 光谱计算。
description.en: All-electron LAPW program focused on excited states: GW, BSE, and TDDFT spectroscopy calculations.

description.zh: 开源全电子 FP-LAPW 程序，适合磁性与非共线自旋体系的精确计算。
description.en: Open-source all-electron FP-LAPW program suitable for accurate calculations of magnetic and non-collinear spin systems.

description.zh: 多体微扰理论程序，基于平面波 DFT 结果计算 GW 准粒子能级与 BSE 激子光谱。
description.en: Many-body perturbation theory program that calculates GW quasiparticle energies and BSE exciton spectra from plane-wave DFT results.

description.zh: 大规模并行的 GW/BSE 程序，用于计算准粒子能带与激子效应。
description.en: Massively parallel GW/BSE program for computing quasiparticle band structures and exciton effects.

description.zh: 构造最局域化 Wannier 函数的工具，用于能带插值、拓扑性质与输运计算。
description.en: Tool for constructing maximally localized Wannier functions, used for band interpolation, topological properties, and transport calculations.

description.zh: 声子计算工具，配合 VASP、QE 等程序得到声子谱、热力学性质和热膨胀。
description.en: Phonon calculation tool that works with VASP, QE, etc. to obtain phonon spectra, thermodynamic properties, and thermal expansion.

description.zh: 用 Julia 编写的平面波 DFT 工具包，代码简洁，适合方法开发与教学。
description.en: Plane-wave DFT toolkit written in Julia, with concise code suitable for method development and teaching.

description.zh: 平面波 DFT 程序，内置联合密度泛函（JDFT）溶剂模型，适合电化学界面。
description.en: Plane-wave DFT program with a built-in joint density functional theory (JDFT) solvation model, suitable for electrochemical interfaces.

description.zh: 分析周期与分子体系电子密度的程序，可做 QTAIM 拓扑分析、NCI 图和晶体结构比较。
description.en: Program for analyzing electron densities in periodic and molecular systems, capable of QTAIM topological analysis, NCI plots, and crystal structure comparison.

description.zh: Henkelman 课题组的 Bader 电荷划分程序，常与 VASP 输出的电荷密度配合使用。
description.en: Bader charge partitioning program from the Henkelman group, often used with charge densities from VASP.

description.zh: 把平面波结果投影到局域基组上做化学键分析（COHP、COOP），用于解释固体中的成键。
description.en: Project plane-wave results onto local basis sets for chemical bonding analysis (COHP, COOP), used to interpret bonding in solids.

description.zh: 计算并可视化内禀成键轨道（IBO）的工具，直观展示化学键与反应中的电子流动。
description.en: Tool for computing and visualizing Intrinsic Bond Orbitals (IBOs), intuitively showing electron flow in chemical bonds and reactions.

description.zh: 自然键轨道（NBO）分析程序，给出 Lewis 结构、电荷和超共轭等化学解释。
description.en: Natural Bond Orbital (NBO) analysis program, providing chemical interpretations such as Lewis structures, charges, and hyperconjugation.

description.zh: 基于 Python 的概念 DFT 与波函数分析工具，计算 Fukui 函数、ELF、NCI 等描述符。
description.en: Python-based conceptual DFT and wavefunction analysis tool for computing Fukui functions, ELF, NCI, and other descriptors.

description.zh: 开源的分子与晶体三维可视化工具，可显示轨道、振动和表面。
description.en: Open-source 3D visualization tool for molecules and crystals, capable of displaying orbitals, vibrations, and surfaces.

description.zh: 分子可视化与轨迹分析程序，常用于分子动力学结果和体数据（如电子密度）的展示。
description.en: Molecular visualization and trajectory analysis program, often used to display molecular dynamics results and volumetric data such as electron densities.

description.zh: 开源的分子编辑与可视化程序，可搭建结构、显示轨道和振动，并作为 Q-Chem 前端。
description.en: Open-source molecular editor and visualization program for building structures, displaying orbitals and vibrations, and serving as a front end to Q-Chem.

description.zh: UCSF 的分子可视化程序，非商业用途免费，擅长大分子结构与体数据显示。
description.en: UCSF's molecular visualization program, free for non-commercial use, specialized in macromolecular structures and volumetric data display.

description.zh: 经典的量子化学结果可视化程序，可显示分子轨道、电子密度和振动模式。
description.en: Classic visualization program for quantum chemistry results, capable of displaying molecular orbitals, electron densities, and vibrational modes.

description.zh: 非绝热分子动力学平台，用面跳跃方法模拟光激发后的动力学过程。
description.en: Non-adiabatic molecular dynamics platform, using surface hopping methods to simulate dynamics after photoexcitation.

description.zh: 面跳跃非绝热动力学程序，可处理系间窜越等任意耦合，并对接多种量子化学程序。
description.en: Surface hopping non-adiabatic dynamics program, capable of handling arbitrary couplings such as intersystem crossing and interfacing with multiple quantum chemistry programs.

description.zh: 多组态含时 Hartree（MCTDH）量子动力学程序包，用于多维核量子动力学模拟。
description.en: Multiconfigurational time-dependent Hartree (MCTDH) quantum dynamics package for multidimensional nuclear quantum dynamics simulations.

description.zh: 量子动力学程序包，包含 MCTDH、G-MCTDH 与直接动力学方法。
description.en: Quantum dynamics package including MCTDH, G-MCTDH, and direct dynamics methods.

description.zh: Qiskit 的化学与物理模块，把分子哈密顿量映射到量子比特，配合 VQE 等算法求解。
description.en: Qiskit's chemistry and physics module, mapping molecular Hamiltonians to qubits and solving them with VQE and other algorithms.

description.zh: Google 的量子化学量子计算库，负责费米子哈密顿量构造与量子比特映射。
description.en: Google's quantum chemistry quantum computing library for fermionic Hamiltonian construction and qubit mapping.

description.zh: PennyLane 的量子化学模块，可构造分子哈密顿量并用可微分量子线路做 VQE。
description.en: PennyLane's quantum chemistry module for constructing molecular Hamiltonians and running VQE with differentiable quantum circuits.

description.zh: 面向量子化学算法开发的抽象层，可在多种量子模拟后端上运行 VQE 等算法。
description.en: Abstraction layer for quantum chemistry algorithm development, capable of running algorithms such as VQE on multiple quantum simulation backends.

description.zh: 腾讯量子实验室的量子计算化学软件包，提供高效的 UCC/VQE 模拟与动力学。
description.en: Quantum computational chemistry software package from Tencent Quantum Lab, providing efficient UCC/VQE simulation and dynamics.

description.zh: NVIDIA 的量子–经典混合编程平台，可在 GPU 上快速模拟量子化学线路。
description.en: NVIDIA's quantum-classical hybrid programming platform for fast simulation of quantum chemistry circuits on GPUs.

description.zh: MIT 开放课程：波函数、薛定谔方程、一维势与谐振子，量子力学入门全套讲义和视频。
description.en: MIT OCW: wave functions, Schrödinger equation, one-dimensional potentials and harmonic oscillator; complete lecture notes and videos for introductory quantum mechanics.

description.zh: MIT 开放课程：狄拉克符号、角动量、自旋与角动量耦合，量子力学的形式体系。
description.en: MIT OCW: Dirac notation, angular momentum, spin, and angular momentum coupling; the formal framework of quantum mechanics.

description.zh: MIT 开放课程：微扰论、WKB 近似、散射与全同粒子，连接到原子分子物理的应用。
description.en: MIT OCW: perturbation theory, WKB approximation, scattering and identical particles, with connections to atomic and molecular physics.

description.zh: MIT 开放课程：从量子力学基础到原子、分子轨道和化学键，化学系的量子化学入门课。
description.en: MIT OCW: from quantum mechanics fundamentals to atoms, molecular orbitals and chemical bonding; an introduction to quantum chemistry for chemistry.

description.zh: MIT 化学系研究生量子力学课程，侧重光谱与分子体系中的应用。
description.en: MIT Chemistry graduate quantum mechanics course, focusing on spectroscopy and molecular systems.

description.zh: MIT 化学系研究生课程：含时量子力学、密度矩阵与光谱学的量子描述。
description.en: MIT Chemistry graduate course: time-dependent quantum mechanics, density matrices, and quantum description of spectroscopy.

description.en: Quantum mechanics entry in the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, explaining conceptual foundations such as Hilbert space formalism and the measurement problem.

description.en: The trillion-parameter version of Intern-S1; the technical report calls it the first trillion-parameter scientific multimodal foundation model, with enhanced reasoning, image-text understanding, and agent capabilities.

description.zh: 上海人工智能实验室 2026 年的科学多模态模型系列（35B 预览版、397B 等），直接从科学文献原始页面做视觉预训练，并加强长流程智能体任务。
description.en: Shanghai AI Laboratory's 2026 scientific multimodal model series (35B preview, 397B, etc.), performs vision pretraining directly from raw pages of scientific literature and strengthens long-horizon agent tasks.

description.en: A scientific foundation model by CAS Panshi team covering math, physics, chemistry, Earth science, astronomy and biology, with 8B, 32B (based on Qwen3) and 671B (based on DeepSeek-R1) variants.

description.en: A model from the Panshi team for long-horizon deep research (8B preview and 32B), focusing on research instruction following, survey report writing, document understanding, and skill invocation.

description.zh: 上海人工智能实验室等的跨学科科学推理模型，把自然语言与分子、蛋白质等科学序列表示对齐，公开 8B 权重。
description.en: An interdisciplinary scientific reasoning model by Shanghai AI Laboratory et al., aligns natural language with scientific sequence representations such as molecules and proteins; 8B weights released.

description.en: A college-level scientific reasoning model trained by Tsinghua University and others on self-reflection annotated scientific instruction data (SciInstruct), covering mathematics, physics, chemistry, and formal proofs.

description.zh: 上海交通大学与苏州实验室的化学对话模型系列；ChemDFM-R（14B）加入官能团等原子化化学知识，专门训练化学推理。
description.en: A chemistry dialogue model series from SJTU and Suzhou Lab; ChemDFM-R (14B) adds atomistic chemical knowledge such as functional groups, specifically trained for chemical reasoning.

description.zh: 上海人工智能实验室、复旦大学等的化学推理模型，分化学基础、推理协议蒸馏、多任务 GRPO 三阶段训练，覆盖分子与反应任务。
description.en: A chemical reasoning model by Shanghai AI Laboratory, Fudan University, etc., with three-stage training: chemistry fundamentals, reasoning protocol distillation, multi-task GRPO, covering molecular and reaction tasks.

description.zh: FutureHouse 基于 Mistral-Small-24B 的 24B 化学推理模型，在 375 类有实验依据的化学任务上做强化学习，用自然语言推理并输出 SMILES。
description.en: FutureHouse's 24B chemical reasoning model based on Mistral-Small-24B, trained with reinforcement learning on 375 experimentally grounded chemistry tasks, reasoning in natural language and outputting SMILES.

description.zh: 上海人工智能实验室基于 InternLM2 的早期开源化学对话模型（7B），面向化学与分子科学问答。
description.en: An early open-source chemistry dialogue model (7B) by Shanghai AI Laboratory based on InternLM2, for chemistry and molecular science Q&A.

description.zh: 华东师范大学的化学模型套件，含化学问答模型 ChemGPT2-QA-72B（基于 Qwen2-72B-Instruct 微调）和逆合成预测，论文 2025 年公开。
description.en: A chemistry model suite from East China Normal University, including ChemGPT2-QA-72B (fine-tuned from Qwen2-72B-Instruct) for chemical Q&A and retrosynthesis prediction; paper released in 2025.

description.zh: 俄亥俄州立大学用三百多万条化学指令数据（SMolInstruct，14 类任务）微调的模型系列，处理分子名称、SMILES 与反应预测等任务。
description.en: A model series fine-tuned by Ohio State University with over three million chemical instruction data (SMolInstruct, 14 task types), handling molecule names, SMILES and reaction prediction tasks.

description.zh: 北京科学智能研究院、上海交通大学等的分子推理框架，先用知识增强的思维链做微调、再用强化学习减少幻觉，用于分子描述和分子生成。
description.en: A molecular reasoning framework by Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, SJTU et al., first fine-tunes with knowledge-enhanced chain-of-thought, then uses reinforcement learning to reduce hallucination, for molecular description and generation.

description.zh: 北京工业大学等以 MOF 吸附为重点的化学推理模型，用 8200 余篇研究论文和 500 篇综述构建思维链数据并做知识蒸馏，2026 年发表于 Digital Discovery。
description.en: A chemical reasoning model focusing on MOF adsorption by Beijing University of Technology et al., built chain-of-thought data from over 8,200 research papers and 500 reviews with knowledge distillation, published in Digital Discovery in 2026.

description.zh: 印度理工学院德里分校等在材料文献和晶体学数据上继续预训练 LLaMA 得到的材料模型系列，含对话版和生成晶体结构的 CIF 版。
description.en: A series of material models from IIT Delhi and others that further pre-train LLaMA on material literature and crystallographic data, including a dialogue version and a CIF version that generates crystal structures.

description.zh: MIT 的 Markus Buehler 微调的力学与材料建模语言模型，用于连接材料失效与多尺度力学知识，2024 年发表于 Applied Mechanics Reviews。
description.en: A mechanics and materials modeling language model fine-tuned by Markus Buehler at MIT, connecting material failure and multiscale mechanics knowledge, published in Applied Mechanics Reviews in 2024.

description.zh: 中国科学院磐石团队基于 Qwen3-VL-32B 的科学图文推理模型，推理时可调用代码裁剪、放大、增强图像后再分析。
description.en: A scientific vision-language reasoning model by CAS Panshi team based on Qwen3-VL-32B; during inference it can call code to crop, zoom, enhance images before analysis.

description.zh: 磐石团队的统一科学多模态推理模型，把文本、材料 CIF、SMILES、蛋白序列、光谱和科学图像放进同一表示，再接各领域的专用解码器。
description.en: A unified scientific multimodal reasoning model from the Panshi team; puts text, material CIF, SMILES, protein sequences, spectra, and scientific images into the same representation, with domain-specific decoders.

description.zh: 上海人工智能实验室、中国科学技术大学等的化学多模态大模型，在文本、SMILES 和分子图像之间做理解与生成。
description.en: A chemical multimodal large model by Shanghai AI Laboratory, USTC, etc., for understanding and generation across text, SMILES and molecular images.

description.zh: 研究如何从研究背景检索启发并组合成科学假设的训练框架，发布灵感检索、假设组合和多任务三个 7B 模型，ICML 2026。
description.en: A training framework for research on retrieving inspiration from research backgrounds and composing scientific hypotheses; released three 7B models for inspiration retrieval, hypothesis composition, and multi-task, ICML 2026.

description.zh: 华盛顿大学与艾伦人工智能研究所等的检索增强模型，从 4500 万篇开放获取论文中找证据并生成带引用的回答，2026 年发表于 Nature。
description.en: A retrieval-augmented model by University of Washington and Allen Institute for AI et al., finds evidence from 45 million open-access papers and generates answers with citations, published in Nature in 2026.

description.zh: Microsoft Research AI for Science 的序列式科学基础模型（8x7B），按自然语言指令生成和优化小分子、蛋白质、RNA 与材料；模型卡说明它不是通用问答模型。
description.en: Microsoft Research AI for Science's sequential scientific foundation model (8x7B) that generates and optimizes small molecules, proteins, RNA and materials from natural language instructions; the model card states it is not a general Q&A model.

description.zh: 在 UniChem 的 1.78 亿个分子上预训练的 3B 化学基础模型，用于分子性质预测、条件分子生成和反应预测，2025 年发表于 Communications Chemistry。
description.en: A 3B chemistry foundation model pre-trained on 178 million molecules from UniChem, for molecular property prediction, conditional molecule generation, and reaction prediction, published in Communications Chemistry in 2025.

description.zh: 用 Psi4 的积分加 NumPy，一步步写出 Hartree–Fock、MP2、耦合簇等方法：交互教程（Jupyter 笔记本）加参考实现，BSD-3 许可。
description.en: Build Hartree–Fock, MP2, coupled cluster and other methods step by step from Psi4 integrals and NumPy: interactive tutorials (Jupyter notebooks) plus reference implementations; BSD-3 licence.

description.zh: 适合化学各门课程的计算化学实验活动，可在 WebMO 演示服务器或 JupyterHub 上在线完成；教师材料需申请，BSD-3 许可。
description.en: Computational chemistry lab activities for courses across the chemistry curriculum, done online on the WebMO demo server or JupyterHub; instructor materials on request; BSD-3 licence.

description.zh: Andrew D. White 的在线教材，讲分子与材料的深度学习，从基础一直讲到图神经网络和等变神经网络；CC BY-NC 3.0（非商业）许可。
description.en: Andrew D. White's online textbook on deep learning for molecules and materials, from the basics to graph and equivariant neural networks; CC BY-NC 3.0 (non-commercial) licence.

items.name: PhET: Models of the Hydrogen Atom

description.zh: 科罗拉多大学 PhET 的交互模拟，面向学原子结构的本科生：比较玻尔、德布罗意和薛定谔等氢原子模型。
description.en: A University of Colorado PhET simulation for undergraduates studying atomic structure: compare the Bohr, de Broglie, Schrödinger and other models of the hydrogen atom.

description.zh: 浏览器里拖拽搭量子线路，每一步实时显示振幅、Bloch 球和密度矩阵；开源，Apache-2.0。本站量子算法展馆的线路模拟器借了它的思路。
description.en: Drag-and-drop quantum circuits in the browser with live amplitudes, Bloch spheres and density matrices at every step; open source, Apache-2.0. The circuit simulator in MolAstria's quantum algorithms pavilion borrows its ideas.

description.zh: 开放量子系统与量子光学的 Python 工具箱：Lindblad 主方程、蒙特卡洛轨迹等求解器，官网附教程笔记本；BSD-3 许可。
description.en: Python toolbox for open quantum systems and quantum optics: Lindblad master-equation and Monte Carlo trajectory solvers, with tutorial notebooks on the website; BSD-3 licence.

description.zh: 网页用的 WebGL 分子查看器 JavaScript 库，读 PDB、SDF、MOL2、XYZ 和 cube 等格式；BSD-3 许可。本站的 3D 分子查看器用的就是它。
description.en: WebGL molecule viewer library for web pages; reads PDB, SDF, MOL2, XYZ, cube and other formats; BSD-3 licence. MolAstria's 3D molecule viewer is built on it.

description.zh: RCSB PDB 和 PDBe 官网集成的开源大分子查看与分析工具包，在浏览器里看蛋白、核酸、配体，以及冷冻电镜密度等体积数据。
description.en: Open-source macromolecular viewer and analysis toolkit integrated into the RCSB PDB and PDBe websites; view proteins, nucleic acids, ligands and volume data such as cryo-EM density in the browser.

description.zh: 结构–性质交互探索器：一边是性质或描述符的散点图，点一个点另一边显示对应的分子或材料结构（反过来也行），适合看机器学习描述符和大批计算结果；BSD 许可。
description.en: Interactive structure–property explorer: a scatter map of properties or descriptors on one side; select a point to see that molecule or material in the viewer, and vice versa. Handy for ML descriptors and large batches of results; BSD licence.

description.zh: 网页里画分子、看 3D 结构、按名称和编号搜化合物；基础功能免费、不用注册，另有付费的高级功能。
description.en: Draw molecules, view them in 3D and search compounds by name or identifier in the browser; the basic features are free with no sign-up, and premium features are paid.

description.zh: 纯 JavaScript 化学信息学库，带分子绘制器和 2D/3D 显示；MIT 许可。本站的“画结构”绘制器用的就是它。
description.en: Pure JavaScript cheminformatics library with a molecule editor and 2D/3D display; MIT licence. MolAstria's "draw a structure" editor uses it.

description.zh: EPAM 的开源网页化学结构编辑器，读写 Molfile（V2000/V3000）、扩展 SMILES、RXN、InChI 等格式；Apache-2.0 许可，有在线演示。
description.en: EPAM's open-source web chemical structure editor; reads and writes Molfile (V2000/V3000), extended SMILES, RXN, InChI and other formats; Apache-2.0, with an online demo.

description.zh: 生物信息学 Python 库：序列与比对、PDB 结构模块、访问 NCBI 的 Entrez 数据库，自带详尽教程；宽松的 Biopython 许可。
description.en: Python library for bioinformatics: sequences and alignments, a PDB structure module and access to NCBI's Entrez databases, with a thorough tutorial; permissive Biopython licence.

description.zh: 在 Google Colab 上用 AlphaFold2 等模型（还有 RoseTTAFold2、ESMFold 等）预测蛋白结构和复合物，用 MMseqs2 快速生成多序列比对；MIT 许可。
description.en: Predict protein structures and complexes on Google Colab with AlphaFold2 and other models (RoseTTAFold2, ESMFold and more), with fast multiple sequence alignments from MMseqs2; MIT licence.

description.zh: 基于 Python 的量子化学框架：HF、DFT、MP2、耦合簇、CASSCF 和周期性体系都能用几行脚本调用，适合方法开发和自动化工作流；Apache-2.0 许可。本站开源代码台能生成 PySCF 脚本。
description.en: Python-based quantum chemistry framework: HF, DFT, MP2, coupled cluster, CASSCF and periodic systems in a few lines of script, well suited to method development and automated workflows; Apache-2.0 licence. MolAstria's Code Desk can generate PySCF scripts.

description.zh: Grimme 组的 GFN-xTB 半经验紧束缚程序：几百个原子的结构优化、频率和分子动力学在普通电脑上也很快，常用来给 DFT 做预筛；LGPL-3.0 许可。
description.en: The Grimme group's GFN-xTB semi-empirical tight-binding program: geometry optimisations, frequencies and molecular dynamics for hundreds of atoms run quickly on an ordinary computer, often used to pre-screen before DFT; LGPL-3.0 licence.

description.zh: 密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）程序，支持 SCC-DFTB、xTB 哈密顿量、激发态和非平衡格林函数电子输运；LGPL-3.0 许可。
description.en: Density functional tight-binding (DFTB) program supporting SCC-DFTB, xTB Hamiltonians, excited states and non-equilibrium Green's function electron transport; LGPL-3.0 licence.

description.zh: 平面波（赝势 / PAW）第一性原理程序，擅长密度泛函微扰理论（声子、介电、弹性）和 GW、Bethe–Salpeter 激发态；主体为 GPL-3.0 许可。
description.en: Plane-wave (pseudopotential / PAW) first-principles code, strong in density functional perturbation theory (phonons, dielectric and elastic response) and GW and Bethe–Salpeter excited states; mostly GPL-3.0.

description.zh: 化学文件格式转换工具箱：在一百多种分子格式之间互转，还能加氢、生成三维坐标、算指纹，命令行和 Python 都能用；GPL-2.0 许可。
description.en: Chemical file-format toolbox: converts between more than a hundred molecular formats, adds hydrogens, generates 3D coordinates and computes fingerprints, from the command line or Python; GPL-2.0 licence.

description.zh: 解析计算化学程序输出的 Python 库：从 Gaussian、ORCA、Psi4、Q-Chem 等十几种程序的输出里读出能量、几何、轨道和振动频率，统一成同一套数据结构；BSD-3 许可。本站开源代码台的输出解读借了它的思路。
description.en: Python library that parses the output of computational chemistry programs: reads energies, geometries, orbitals and vibrational frequencies from more than a dozen programs such as Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4 and Q-Chem into one data structure; BSD-3 licence. The output reader in MolAstria's Code Desk borrows its ideas.

description.zh: 分子动力学轨迹分析的 Python 库，读 GROMACS、AMBER、NAMD、LAMMPS 等几十种格式，做 RMSD、氢键、径向分布函数等分析；库整体按 LGPL-3.0+ 发布。
description.en: Python library for analysing molecular dynamics trajectories; reads dozens of formats from GROMACS, AMBER, NAMD, LAMMPS and more, with RMSD, hydrogen-bond, radial distribution function and other analyses; the library as a whole is released under LGPL-3.0+.

description.zh: 轻量快速的分子动力学轨迹读写与分析库，常用于 RMSD、二级结构（DSSP）和接触图，和 NumPy 无缝衔接；LGPL-2.1 许可。
description.en: Lightweight, fast library for reading, writing and analysing molecular dynamics trajectories, commonly used for RMSD, secondary structure (DSSP) and contact maps, working seamlessly with NumPy; LGPL-2.1 licence.

description.zh: GPU 加速的通用粒子模拟 Python 包，擅长软物质、胶体和硬粒子蒙特卡洛；BSD-3 许可。
description.en: GPU-accelerated general-purpose particle simulation package for Python, strong in soft matter, colloids and hard-particle Monte Carlo; BSD-3 licence.

description.zh: 深度势能（Deep Potential）模型的训练和推理工具，可接 LAMMPS、GROMACS 等做大规模分子动力学，常和 DP-GEN 主动学习一起用；LGPL-3.0 许可。
description.en: Training and inference toolkit for Deep Potential models, plugging into LAMMPS, GROMACS and others for large-scale molecular dynamics, often used together with DP-GEN active learning; LGPL-3.0 licence.

description.zh: 高阶等变消息传递的机器学习原子势，提供 MACE-MP-0、MACE-OFF 等现成的基础模型，可接 ASE 和 LAMMPS；MIT 许可。本站模型接口的 MACE-OMOL-0 就来自它。
description.en: Machine-learned interatomic potentials built on higher-order equivariant message passing, with ready-made foundation models such as MACE-MP-0 and MACE-OFF, usable from ASE and LAMMPS; MIT licence. MACE-OMOL-0 on MolAstria's model API comes from it.

description.zh: E(3) 等变图神经网络原子势，用较少的训练数据就能达到高精度；MIT 许可。
description.en: E(3)-equivariant graph neural network interatomic potentials that reach high accuracy from relatively little training data; MIT licence.

description.zh: NequIP 团队的严格局域等变原子势，便于并行扩展到超大体系的分子动力学；MIT 许可。
description.en: Strictly local equivariant interatomic potentials from the NequIP team, designed to scale in parallel to molecular dynamics of very large systems; MIT licence.

description.zh: 基于 PyTorch 的原子尺度神经网络工具箱，内置 SchNet、PaiNN 等模型，能训练能量、力、偶极等性质并跑分子动力学；MIT 许可。
description.en: PyTorch toolbox for atomistic neural networks with built-in models such as SchNet and PaiNN; trains energies, forces, dipoles and other properties and runs molecular dynamics; MIT licence.

description.zh: PyTorch 实现的神经网络势框架，包含等变 Transformer、TensorNet 等架构；MIT 许可。
description.en: Neural network potential framework in PyTorch, including the equivariant Transformer, TensorNet and other architectures; MIT licence.

description.zh: MolSSI 制定的量子化学计算 JSON 交换格式：分子、方法和结果用同一套字段描述，QCEngine、Psi4、QCArchive 都用它；BSD-3 许可。本站开源代码台能把分子导出成 QCSchema。
description.en: MolSSI's JSON exchange format for quantum chemistry calculations: molecules, methods and results described with one set of fields, used by QCEngine, Psi4 and QCArchive; BSD-3 licence. MolAstria's Code Desk can export molecules as QCSchema.

description.zh: MolSSI 的基础数据与模型库：元素周期表、CODATA 物理常数、单位换算和 QCSchema 分子模型的校验；BSD-3 许可。
description.en: MolSSI's library of basic data and models: periodic table, CODATA physical constants, unit conversion and validation of QCSchema molecule models; BSD-3 licence.

description.zh: QCArchive 背后的服务器软件：批量提交、调度和存储量子化学计算，也可以自己部署一套；BSD-3 许可。
description.en: The server software behind QCArchive: submits, schedules and stores quantum chemistry calculations in bulk, and you can deploy your own instance; BSD-3 licence.

description.zh: 联合国教科文组织支持的源代码永久档案，收录 GitHub、GitLab、PyPI 等平台的公开代码及完整历史；用 SWHID 标识符引用某一版本，复现论文时比 main 分支的链接可靠。
description.en: Permanent source-code archive supported by UNESCO, holding public code and full history from GitHub, GitLab, PyPI and other platforms; cite an exact version with a SWHID identifier, which is more reliable than a link to a main branch when reproducing a paper.

description.zh: CERN 运营的开放科研仓库：上传数据、代码和论文附件即得 DOI；和 GitHub 联动后，每发布一个版本就自动存档并分配 DOI。
description.en: Open research repository run by CERN: upload data, code or paper supplements and get a DOI; linked to GitHub, it archives every release automatically and assigns it a DOI.

description.zh: 社区维护的 conda 软件源，PySCF、Psi4、xTB、OpenMM、RDKit 等计算化学软件大多能用一条命令装好。
description.en: Community-maintained conda package channel; most computational chemistry software, including PySCF, Psi4, xTB, OpenMM and RDKit, installs with one command.

description.zh: 机器学习模型、数据集和在线演示的托管平台，化学和材料方向的不少模型权重（如 UMA）和数据集（如 OMol25）在这里发布；权重的许可证要单独看。
description.en: Hosting platform for machine learning models, datasets and online demos; many chemistry and materials model weights (such as UMA) and datasets (such as OMol25) are released here; check each model's weight licence separately.

description.zh: Google 发起的开源漏洞数据库，覆盖 PyPI、npm、crates.io 等生态，可按包名和版本查已知漏洞，有免费 API。本站开源代码台的软件体检用它。
description.en: Open-source vulnerability database started by Google, covering PyPI, npm, crates.io and other ecosystems; look up known vulnerabilities by package name and version through a free API. The software check-up in MolAstria's Code Desk uses it.

description.zh: Quantum ESPRESSO 的连续介质嵌入插件：隐式溶剂（自洽连续溶剂模型 SCCS）、电解质和外加电场，常用来算固液界面和电化学体系；GPL-2.0 许可。
多尺度模拟工具包：CSG 把全原子分子动力学粗化成珠子模型（迭代 Boltzmann 反演、力匹配），XTP 用 GW-BSE 和 QM/MM 算激发态，再用动力学蒙特卡洛模拟有机半导体里的电荷和激子输运；Apache-2.0 许可。
